label: Rabies-neutralizing antibody — minimum titre for import
appliesTo: Dogs and cats aged 90 days or older arriving from a rabies-affected country or region. Animals under 90 days, and those from areas Korea currently recognises as rabies-free, are treated differently — but still need identification and certification.
why: A vaccination record is not this test, and owners arrive believing it is. The requirement is a laboratory result at or above the titre, from a recognised laboratory or the exporting government, within the current validity window.

history.source: Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency import standard effective 2026-09-30
history.note: Checked within 24 months of the blood-draw date under the current rule.
